AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/SceneViewGestures.qml
IMPORT net.asivery.CommandExecutor 1.0
    TRAVERSE TouchArea
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
    INSERT {
        // Fullscreen WeRead reader, patched into xochitl's existing QML
        // tree via qt-resource-rebuilder (see docs/design.md §"为什么走
        // patch 而不是 AppLoad"). Same mechanism as rm-agent's
        // three_finger_translate.qmd — a normally-hidden Item plus
        // file-based IPC with a native daemon — just scaled up from a
        // small popup to a fullscreen surface.
        //
        // NOTE: every comment in this file has to live inside this
        // INSERT block. The .qmd grammar only accepts AFFECT / SLOT /
        // VERSION / TEMPLATE at the top level, so a `//` line before
        // AFFECT makes qmldiff reject the whole file ("expected AFFECT
        // ... got Identifier(\"//\")") — confirmed on device. It fails
        // safely (the patch just doesn't load) but silently, so the
        // reader would simply never appear.
        //
        // A SEPARATE .qmd from rm-agent's, deliberately:
        // qt-resource-rebuilder iterates the directory and loads every
        // .qmd it finds (also confirmed on device — both files show up
        // as "Loading file ..."), so the two projects' patches coexist
        // without either repo knowing about the other's file, and
        // without repeating the "two copies of one .qmd drift apart"
        // incident.
        //
        // This QML runs INSIDE xochitl's process. A mistake here doesn't
        // just break the reader, it can crash xochitl into a reboot
        // loop — always validate with `xovi/debug` in the foreground
        // before making it persistent.
        //
        // Rust does the line wrapping (paginate.rs); this file renders
        // the already-wrapped lines verbatim and must never re-wrap
        // them, or the character offsets annotations depend on stop
        // matching what's on screen.

        // Four fingers, so it can't be confused with rm-agent's
        // three-finger translate gesture patched into this same file.
        TouchAreaClickFilter {
            id: weReadOpenFilter
            palmAreaThreshold: touchArea.tapPalmThreshold
            enabled: !touchArea.panAndZoomOnly
            fingers: 4
            onClick: {
                weReadReader.visible = true;
                weReadReader.statusText = "正在打开…";
                weReadReader.bodyText = "";
                weReadReader.lastSeq = weReadReader.readSeq();
                weReadCmd.executeCommand("/bin/touch", ["/home/root/xovi/exthome/weread/open"]);
                weReadPoller.start();
            }
        }

        CommandExecutor {
            id: weReadCmd
        }

        FontLoader {
            id: weReadFont
            source: "file:///home/root/xovi/exthome/weread/NotoSansSC.ttf"
        }

        Rectangle {
            id: weReadReader
            visible: false
            // Above rm-agent's translate popup (z: 1000) so the two can
            // never fight over the screen.
            z: 2000
            color: "white"
            width: touchArea.width
            height: touchArea.height
            x: 0
            y: 0

            property int lastSeq: 0
            property string statusText: ""
            property string titleText: ""
            property string pageInfo: ""
            property string bodyText: ""

            function readResultFile() {
                var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
                try {
                    xhr.open("GET", "file:///home/root/xovi/exthome/weread/page.txt", false);
                    xhr.send();
                    return xhr.responseText || "";
                } catch (e) {
                    return "";
                }
            }

            function readSeq() {
                var raw = readResultFile();
                var n = parseInt(raw.split("\n")[0]);
                return isNaN(n) ? 0 : n;
            }

            // Swallows every touch inside the reader so nothing reaches
            // the document underneath — without this, a page-turn tap
            // would also flip the real document behind us.
            MouseArea {
                id: weReadCapture
                anchors.fill: parent
                onClicked: (mouse) => {
                    if (mouse.y < weReadReader.height * 0.12) {
                        // Top strip closes.
                        weReadReader.visible = false;
                        weReadPoller.stop();
                        weReadCmd.executeCommand("/bin/touch", ["/home/root/xovi/exthome/weread/close"]);
                        return;
                    }
                    var file = mouse.x < weReadReader.width * 0.35
                        ? "/home/root/xovi/exthome/weread/prev"
                        : "/home/root/xovi/exthome/weread/next";
                    weReadReader.lastSeq = weReadReader.readSeq();
                    weReadCmd.executeCommand("/bin/touch", [file]);
                    weReadPoller.start();
                }
            }

            Text {
                id: weReadTitle
                anchors.top: parent.top
                anchors.topMargin: 40
                anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
                font.family: weReadFont.name
                font.pixelSize: 26
                color: "#606060"
                text: weReadReader.titleText
            }

            Text {
                id: weReadBody
                anchors.top: parent.top
                anchors.topMargin: 110
                anchors.left: parent.left
                anchors.leftMargin: 60
                anchors.right: parent.right
                anchors.rightMargin: 60
                font.family: weReadFont.name
                font.pixelSize: 34
                lineHeight: 1.45
                color: "black"
                // Rust already wrapped these lines to fit; re-wrapping
                // here would desync the on-screen text from the
                // character offsets annotations rely on.
                wrapMode: Text.NoWrap
                textFormat: Text.PlainText
                text: weReadReader.bodyText
            }

            Text {
                id: weReadStatus
                anchors.centerIn: parent
                font.family: weReadFont.name
                font.pixelSize: 30
                color: "#808080"
                visible: weReadReader.statusText.length > 0
                text: weReadReader.statusText
            }

            Text {
                id: weReadFooter
                anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
                anchors.bottomMargin: 36
                anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
                font.family: weReadFont.name
                font.pixelSize: 22
                color: "#909090"
                text: weReadReader.pageInfo
            }
        }

        Timer {
            id: weReadPoller
            interval: 300
            repeat: true
            property int elapsedMs: 0
            onTriggered: {
                elapsedMs += interval;
                var raw = weReadReader.readResultFile();
                var lines = raw.split("\n");
                var seq = parseInt(lines[0]);
                if (!isNaN(seq) && seq > weReadReader.lastSeq) {
                    weReadReader.lastSeq = seq;
                    var status = lines.length > 1 ? lines[1] : "";
                    weReadReader.titleText = lines.length > 2 ? lines[2] : "";
                    weReadReader.pageInfo = lines.length > 3 ? lines[3] : "";
                    if (status === "page") {
                        weReadReader.statusText = "";
                        weReadReader.bodyText = lines.length > 4 ? lines.slice(4).join("\n") : "";
                    } else {
                        weReadReader.statusText = lines.length > 4 ? lines.slice(4).join("\n") : "(出错)";
                        weReadReader.bodyText = "";
                    }
                    // "loading" is a progress note, not an answer — the
                    // daemon will write again when the fetch finishes.
                    // Stopping here is what previously left the reader
                    // stuck on "正在打开…" forever.
                    if (status === "loading") {
                        elapsedMs = 0;
                        return;
                    }
                    elapsedMs = 0;
                    stop();
                    return;
                }
                if (elapsedMs > 60000) {
                    weReadReader.statusText = "(超时，请重试)";
                    elapsedMs = 0;
                    stop();
                }
            }
        }
    }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
